$comment: Overlay precedence shared by .NET (Runic.Translations.Generator.Tests CompositionTests, TranslationContext.AddOverlay) and the web (Runic.Translations.Compiler.Tests Rmf2EsmOverlayTests, dynamic.js installOverlay). Each overlay is a relaxed-completeness project of the catalog's ID; packs lists the locale artifacts it supplies (all by default). On the web each pack is one install, in overlay order, with the fallback its addedLocales entry names.
